# Australian Electric Motor Co

> Australia's Premier Electric Dirt Bike Specialist & High-Voltage Moto Engineering

Australian Electric Motor Co (AEMC) engineers and supplies competition-grade electric dirt bikes, heavy-duty outback agricultural e-motos, 72V lithium battery architectures, and CNC billet performance parts designed to conquer red bull-dust, creek crossings, and steep Australian singletrack. Registered for GST in NSW with nationwide crate logistics.

## Business & Contact
- Location: Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
- Country of Operation: Australia
- Currency: AUD
- WhatsApp: +61 480 811 308
- Email: riders@australianelectricmotorco.com.au
- Minimum Order: $0 AUD
- Free Shipping Threshold: $150 AUD
- Payment Methods: crypto-BTC, crypto-USDT, pay-in-4, bank-transfer, payid
- Crypto Settlement Discount: 10% off total order (BTC / USDT)
- Consumer Financing: Pay in 4 (4 equal fortnightly payments, 0% interest)

## Product Categories
- [Electric Dirt Bikes](https://australianelectricmotorco.com.au/shop/electric-dirt-bikes/): Explore Australia’s premier collection of competition-spec electric dirt bikes, agile trail weapons, street-legal commuters, and heavy-duty farm workhorses.
- [Adult Electric Dirt Bikes](https://australianelectricmotorco.com.au/shop/adult-electric-dirt-bikes/): High-power 60V, 72V, and 360V machines delivering up to 60kW peak output for adult riders tackling demanding Australian motocross tracks and bush singletrack.
- [Full-Size Motocross](https://australianelectricmotorco.com.au/shop/full-size-motocross/): Competition-level full-size electric motocross bikes matching and exceeding 450cc four-strokes with 21"/18" wheelsets, long-travel suspension, and holeshot-winning torque.
- [Trail & Mid-Weight Enduro](https://australianelectricmotorco.com.au/shop/trail-mid-weight-enduro/): Nimble, high-endurance trail e-dirt bikes built for rocky ridges, mountain singletrack, and outback bush navigation with up to 140km range per charge.
- [Kids & Youth Electric Dirt Bikes](https://australianelectricmotorco.com.au/shop/kids-youth-electric-dirt-bikes/): Safe, durable, governor-controlled electric dirt bikes that build skill and confidence in young Aussie groms without hot exhaust pipes or loud engine noise.
